description: CumulativeMetrics in src/holon_coherence/proxy/metrics.py and OfflineMetricsAccumulator in src/holon_coherence/metrics/aggregation.py duplicate turn-sample recording and average/rate computations, and proxy/metrics.py repeats the same positive ttft guard twice in record_response.
goal: Extract shared rate, average, and sample-accumulator helpers into src/holon_coherence/metrics_math.py (staying at most 200 lines) so both src/holon_coherence/proxy/metrics.py (at most 200 lines) and src/holon_coherence/metrics/aggregation.py (at most 222 lines, reducing its line count without editing holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json) share one core aggregation implementation without changing any existing JSON output fields or values. Remove the duplicate 'if ttft is not None and ttft > 0:' condition in proxy/metrics.py's record_response, and add parity tests in tests/proxy/test_metrics.py and tests/test_metrics_aggregation.py proving live CumulativeMetrics and offline OfflineMetricsAccumulator yield matching aggregates and rates across identical turn streams. Keep zero docstrings and zero comments across all touched files so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes, and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Consolidating live and offline metric aggregation into metrics_math.py removes DRY drift between dashboard telemetry and offline evaluation scorecards while shrinking metrics/aggregation.py.
acceptance_criteria: src/holon_coherence/metrics_math.py provides shared metric accumulation helpers used by both live CumulativeMetrics (src/holon_coherence/proxy/metrics.py) and offline OfflineMetricsAccumulator (src/holon_coherence/metrics/aggregation.py), staying at or below 200 / 200 / 222 lines respectively without modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.
src/holon_coherence/proxy/metrics.py no longer repeats two adjacent 'if ttft is not None and ttft > 0:' guards in record_response.

tests/proxy/test_metrics.py and tests/test_metrics_aggregation.py assert matching aggregate outputs between live CumulativeMetrics and offline OfflineMetricsAccumulator with zero docstrings or comments, and 'uv run pytest' plus 'uv run task lint' pass cleanly.
